                print(line.split(':',1)[1].strip())

except Exception:
    pass
data = open(path,'rb').read()
# Count /Type /Page objects that are not /Pages
import re
# Common approach: count /Type /Page not followed by s
pages = len(re.findall(rb'/Type\s*/Page(?!s)', data))
print(pages)
